title: 会做梦的AI，为什么记不住？
title_en: This AI Dreams Up Worlds. Then It Forgets.

segments.zh: Google built an AI that dreams up a world you can walk around in.
segments.en: 谷歌造了一个AI，能凭空“梦”出一个你能走进去的世界。

segments.zh: But turn around too long, and the world forgets.
segments.en: 可你转身太久，这个世界就忘了。

segments.zh: It's called Genie four.
segments.en: 它叫Genie 4，

segments.zh: It was announced on October twenty seventh.
segments.en: 10月27号发布。

segments.zh: Type a sentence, and it paints a world,
segments.en: 打一句话，它就画出一个世界，

segments.zh: with sound, weather, and people who talk back.
segments.en: 有声音、有天气，还有会搭话的人。

segments.zh: You can walk around with the arrow keys,
segments.en: 你可以用方向键在里面走来走去，

segments.zh: just like a normal game.
segments.en: 就像玩普通游戏。

segments.zh: Every picture and sound it makes
segments.en: 每一帧画面和声音，

segments.zh: carries an invisible watermark.
segments.en: 都打了看不见的水印。

segments.zh: It's called SynthID,
segments.en: 它叫SynthID，

segments.zh: so people can tell an AI made it.
segments.en: 好让大家认出这是AI做的。

segments.zh: Today's brain-teaser: it's not a game engine,
segments.en: 今天的烧脑问题：它不是游戏引擎，

segments.zh: so how does it know what comes next?
segments.en: 它怎么知道下一秒该是什么样？

segments.zh: First, a secret: there's no map inside.
segments.en: 先说个秘密：它里面没有地图，

segments.zh: No walls. No physics code.
segments.en: 没有墙，也没有物理公式。

segments.zh: A normal video game stores everything:
segments.en: 普通游戏把一切都存着：

segments.zh: where the tree is, how heavy the box is.
segments.en: 树在哪，箱子多重。

segments.zh: Genie stores nothing like that.
segments.en: Genie什么都不存，

segments.zh: It just guesses the next picture.
segments.en: 它只猜下一张画面。

segments.zh: Then it guesses the next one,
segments.en: 猜完一张，再猜下一张，

segments.zh: and the next, many times a second.
segments.en: 一秒钟猜很多张。

segments.zh: Your phone's keyboard guesses the next word.
segments.en: 手机输入法猜下一个字，

segments.zh: Genie guesses the next whole picture.
segments.en: Genie猜的是下一整张画。

segments.zh: It's like a flip book artist
segments.en: 就像一个画翻页小人书的画家，

segments.zh: drawing each page by looking at the last few.
segments.en: 每页都照着前几页画。

segments.zh: So how does it know a ball falls down?
segments.en: 那它怎么知道球会往下掉？

segments.zh: It watched a huge amount of video.
segments.en: 因为它看过海量的视频。

segments.zh: After enough video, falling looks normal,
segments.en: 看多了，往下掉就显得正常，

segments.zh: and floating looks wrong.
segments.en: 飘在空中就显得不对劲。

segments.zh: No equations.
segments.en: 没有公式，

segments.zh: Just patterns, seen over and over.
segments.en: 只有看了一遍又一遍的规律。

segments.zh: Twist one:
segments.en: 反转一：

segments.zh: nobody taught it gravity.
segments.en: 没有人教过它重力。

segments.zh: Its physics is a habit, not a law.
segments.en: 它的物理是习惯，不是定律，

segments.zh: Like a toddler who knows cups fall, but not why.
segments.en: 就像小娃娃知道杯子会掉，却不知道为什么。

segments.zh: So tricky physics, like splashing water or stacking blocks,
segments.en: 所以水花四溅、积木叠高这种复杂的物理，

segments.zh: is where it slips.
segments.en: 最容易露馅。

segments.zh: Twist two, the weird one:
segments.en: 反转二，最反直觉：

segments.zh: the hard part isn't drawing. It's memory.
segments.en: 最难的不是画，是记性。

segments.zh: To keep the world the same,
segments.en: 想让世界保持一致，

segments.zh: it has to look back at pages it already drew.
segments.en: 它得回头翻已经画过的页。

segments.zh: Every extra second it remembers
segments.en: 多记一秒，每画一页

segments.zh: means more pages to check, for every new page.
segments.en: 就要多翻好多页。

segments.zh: It's like rereading the whole book
segments.en: 就像每写一个新字，

segments.zh: every time you write one new word.
segments.en: 都要把整本书重读一遍。

segments.zh: That's why its memory is measured in minutes,
segments.en: 所以记性是按分钟算的，

segments.zh: not hours.
segments.en: 不是按小时。

segments.zh: Genie four keeps a scene consistent for up to two minutes,
segments.en: Genie 4能让一个场景保持一致最多两分钟，

segments.zh: about double Genie three.
segments.en: 大约是Genie 3的两倍。

segments.zh: After that, details can drift:
segments.en: 再久一点，细节就会漂：

segments.zh: the tree behind you might quietly move.
segments.en: 你身后的树，可能悄悄挪了地方。

segments.zh: It's the telephone game:
segments.en: 这就像传话游戏：

segments.zh: every copy of a copy gets a little more wrong.
segments.en: 每传一次，就错一点点。

segments.zh: A real game engine never forgets.
segments.en: 真正的游戏引擎从来不忘，

segments.zh: It just looks up where the tree is.
segments.en: 它直接去查那棵树的位置。

segments.zh: Google itself says objects can drift,
segments.en: 谷歌自己也说，物体会漂，

segments.zh: especially in long runs and after lots of edits.
segments.en: 尤其是跑得久、改得多的时候。

segments.zh: And you can edit while you play:
segments.en: 而且你可以边玩边改：

segments.zh: type make it rain, and it rains.
segments.en: 打一句“下雨”，就下雨了。

segments.zh: Twist three:
segments.en: 反转三：

segments.zh: the biggest customer might be robots.
segments.en: 最大的用户，可能是机器人。

segments.zh: Training a robot in the real world is slow,
segments.en: 在真实世界里训练机器人很慢，

segments.zh: and broken robots are expensive.
segments.en: 摔坏一台还很贵。

segments.zh: In a dream world, a robot can drop a cup
segments.en: 在梦里，机器人可以把杯子摔一千次，

segments.zh: a thousand times for free.
segments.en: 一分钱不花。

segments.zh: It could also invent rare moments,
segments.en: 它还可以编出少见的场面，

segments.zh: like a cat darting under the robot's feet.
segments.en: 比如一只猫突然钻到机器人脚下。

segments.zh: In one Google test, Gemini split a robot task into steps,
segments.en: 谷歌试过：Gemini把机器人的任务拆成几步，

segments.zh: and Genie four acted out each step on the spot.
segments.en: Genie 4当场把每一步演出来。

segments.zh: A planner on top,
segments.en: 上面一个会计划的，

segments.zh: a dreamer underneath.
segments.en: 下面一个会做梦的。

segments.zh: Fine print: it's a research preview,
segments.en: 友情提示：现在只是研究预览，

segments.zh: only for invited testers right now.
segments.en: 只给受邀测试者用。

segments.zh: Google says that in the coming weeks
segments.en: 谷歌说，接下来几周

segments.zh: it opens to some paid subscribers and developers.
segments.en: 会开放给部分付费用户和开发者。

segments.zh: Writing inside the world, accurate sound, and tricky physics
segments.en: 世界里的文字、声音准不准、复杂的物理，

segments.zh: are all still being worked on.
segments.en: 都还在研究。

segments.zh: Genie three came out just over a year ago.
segments.en: Genie 3一年多前才出来，

segments.zh: This field is moving fast.
segments.en: 这一行跑得飞快。

segments.zh: Our worry, not a finding: a robot that trusts a bad dream
segments.en: 我们的担心是：机器人要是信了一个错的梦，

segments.zh: might learn bad moves.
segments.en: 可能学会错的动作。

segments.zh: So how does it know what comes next?
segments.en: 所以它怎么知道下一秒？

segments.zh: It doesn't. It just guesses really, really well.
segments.en: 它不知道，它只是猜得非常非常好。

segments.zh: And when you turn around,
segments.en: 而你转身的时候，

segments.zh: it's hoping you won't check.
segments.en: 它只盼着你别回头检查。

segments.zh: Just like me
segments.en: 就像我说“我记得你的名字”的时候，

segments.zh: when I say I remember your name.
segments.en: 一样。
